title: Automated Earnings Parser
author: Life_Aquatic_2099
selftext:
I am currently in the process of building a system to automatically parse through and pull the relevant information from stock earnings as they are released.

I am building this with Claude code, and having issues with slight delays in it finding the earnings as soon as it’s released (the main edge here is timing so that’s an issue) and even when I does the parsing system I have built isn’t always great at finding the relevant info - Adjusted EPS, Revenue and guidance each to then be compared to the consensus).

Has anyone had any success with either building an earning identification system or parsing system that can give some advice?

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Timing and parsing are really two separate problems, so I'd fix them separately. For speed, pull from the source directly (the company press release wire or the SEC 8-K feed) instead of waiting on a news site. For parsing, build a small test set of past releases with the right EPS, revenue and guidance filled in, and score every change against it. That way a fix for one company shows up right away if it breaks ten others, and you stop patching one issue at a time. Also keep a log of each miss by type, like wrong table or guidance in plain text, so you fix the pattern and not the single case. If you also like trading around news and events, Cymetica's Event Cards are another way to do it with stocks and crypto.
